    AI Overview
    Melania Trump is originally from Novo Mesto, Slovenia (formerly part of Yugoslavia), where she was born on April 26, 1970. Raised in Sevnica, she began a modeling career at age 16 before moving to New York in 1996. She is the second foreign-born First Lady of the United States, becoming a citizen in 2006. 
    Key details regarding her origin: 
    • Birth Name: Melanija Knavs.
    • Education: Studied architecture and design at the University of Ljubljana.
    • Background: Grew up in the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, which is now the independent nation of Slovenia.
    • Citizenship: She became a naturalized U.S. citizen in 2006.
